BiltFlow

The intelligent operating system for construction.

Connect feasibility, drawings and takeoff with procurement, project delivery, claims and reporting.

Book a demo →
BiltFlow lifecycle

From site feasibility to subcontractor payment.

Follow the project records that connect planning, design coordination, procurement and delivery.

BiltFlow workflow

From site feasibility to programme and workforce planning.

See module handoffs and payment records
  1. 01
    SiteScope

    Scope the site

    Compare feasibility scenarios and capture site constraints.

    HandoffFeasibility assumptions and site constraints

  2. 02
    Pulse

    Plan the program

    Build the baseline schedule with phases, dependencies and milestones.

    HandoffMilestones and required-on-site dates

  3. 03
    Vault

    Coordinate drawings and documents

    Create project records and drawing registers. Upload, review, revise and share drawings and documents with controlled access.

    HandoffReviewed drawing revisions and scope documents

  4. 04
    BOQ Engine & Estimator

    Quantify and price the scope

    Extract quantities from drawings and apply trade rates to build the bill of quantities.

    HandoffQuantities and cost breakdown for trade packages

  5. 05
    ProcureFlow

    Tender and award

    Build packages, issue RFQs, compare bids and award subcontractor contracts.

    HandoffAwarded contract, scope and agreed rates

  6. 06
    PayFlow

    Assess claims and manage payment

    Review progress claims against awarded scope, contract terms and program milestones. Certify approved amounts for payment.

    Payment recordCertified amounts and payment status

ResourceFlow

Plan capacity throughout delivery

Use Pulse phases and dates to forecast demand by role and skill. Allocate people across projects, track utilisation and adjust assignments when dates or workloads change.

Delivery feedback When drawings, lead times or milestones change, review the affected quantities, procurement packages and resource allocations.

Deployment

Connect the workflow to your business.

Link drawing revisions in Vault to the quantities, procurement packages and programme milestones that need review.

Discuss your systems, access controls and approval requirements with our implementation team.
